title: UFO Sighting Over Hawaii: Flight Swerves to Avoid Mysterious White Object as Airline Denies Claim
description: A passenger on a Mokulele Airlines flight in Hawaii claims her plane swerved to avoid a UFO emerging from cloud, even as the airline and US regulators say they have no record of a near-miss.

title: Dr. Phil claims Trump recruited him to review UFO files and found government cover-up
description: Dr. Phil said the White House recruited him to analyze how people might react to learning humans are "somewhere different in the food chain."

title: Are we alone? These UFO researchers in Toronto intend to find out — and they want you to take them seriously
